DogeOS aims to move Dogecoin from being a passive token to an app platform.
If you’re curious about where Dogecoin’s tech ecosystem is headed, it’s worth keeping an eye on.
@DogeOS

What will be possible on DogeOS?
– dApps running on DOGE
– Mini games
– NFT and staking systems
– AI-powered trading tools
All built on Dogecoin’s infrastructure.

📌 DogeOS is an application platform built for Dogecoin.
Its goal: to provide an infrastructure where apps that run on DOGE can be developed.
So Dogecoin won’t just be a transfer token anymore — it will also power apps.

Have you heard of DogeOS?
It’s a new app layer built by the Dogecoin community.
In this thread, I’ll briefly explain what DogeOS is, how it works, and why it was created 👇

6⃣This thread gives a short look at the architecture behind DogeOS.

It’s exciting to see Dogecoin evolving from just a meme coin into a modular, app‑friendly ecosystem.

If I missed something or got it wrong — I’d love your feedback.

Much wow. Such future. 🚀

4⃣And for users?

It means familiar DeFi and EVM-based apps can exist on Dogecoin.

A massive number of people already use EVM apps — this is a chance to bring them into the Dogecoin ecosystem.

3⃣The beauty of this?
 Developers don’t need to learn a new coding language.
With zkVM + EVM compatibility, thousands of existing Ethereum developers can build on Dogecoin with little friction.

That’s a huge opportunity for dev adoption.

2⃣Why zk?

Because DogeOS aims to use a zkVM (zero-knowledge virtual machine) — this allows building on Dogecoin while still relying on its native security.

At the same time, it unlocks EVM capabilities:
– DeFi
– Gaming
– NFTs
– And more.
